Contains an ordered array of Relative Absolute file offsets to each Cell record under the Worldspace. 4 bytes are all 00 if the cell the entry in the array relates to, is not present in the plugin in question. When Present, the engine direct loads the Cell and its References from the Offset, instead of seeking down the Blocks/Sub-Blocks to find them.
